ideas.title: Following the Money in Georgia's Election Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial aspects of the Georgia election investigation, including any potential money laundering or campaign finance irregularities.
questions: What financial irregularities have been uncovered in the investigation?
How have campaign finances been used in the election?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money in this investigation will reveal significant insights into the potential for election fraud and corruption. By analyzing campaign finance records and financial transactions, we may uncover a trail of evidence that leads to the root of the problem.
